title: Configuration embedded in the first branch
statement: Let $N_0$ and $N_1$ be finite nondeterministic Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, and let $x$ be a Boolean input string. A configuration of $N_0$ on $x$ is sent to a configuration of their combined machine on the same input by embedding its state in the first summand (preserving a halting state), retaining its input-head position and output, and placing its work tapes and head positions in the first block. Every tape in the second block is blank at every position and has its head at position $0$.
hypotheses_covered: Two finite nondeterministic Turing machines over Bool
A configuration of the first machine on that input
